about: Reviewed exceptions of the ISA isolation guard (scripts/check-isa-isolation.py, ADR-0134 §6). kernel_symbols: non-local symbols a kernel object may define outside its level namespace, all compiler- or runtime-generated, none a body a baseline unit could share. floor: above-floor code general code may hold, each entry naming the runtime check that guards it (allows: encodings VEX/EVEX or mnemonics; scope: symbol, owner or guard_symbol regexes).

kernel_symbols.reason: MSVC floating-point and vector constants: read-only COMDAT data named by their bytes
MSVC string literals: read-only COMDAT data named by their bytes
MSVC's empty fallback for the global operator delete, generated in every unit with a virtual destructor; its body is a return
MSVC STL's constant digit-pair table (inline variable template): data, no code
UCRT <wchar.h> selectany constant: data, no code
MSVC's selectany default of the CRT's __isa_available, emitted beside the vectorizer's own runtime dispatch: data, no code
the C++ and C exception-handling personality references (ThreadSanitizer's function-exit cleanups unwind with the C one): data
AddressSanitizer's ODR indicator of an instrumented global and Clang's once-per-image flag of the globals' registration, emitted in every unit with globals: data generated by the compiler
Clang source-based coverage counters, records, version and file name and the runtime hook: instrumentation generated by the compiler in every instrumented unit
Clang's shared handler for an exception leaving a noexcept function (Itanium ABI): it calls __cxa_begin_catch and std::terminate, no vector code

floor.guard: the function tests __isa_available (set from CPUID by the CRT) before each path above SSE2: MSVC's vectorizer emits such paths at /O2 under every /arch (EVEX vpmullq for 64-bit index products, SSE4.1 pmaxud, pmovzxdq), and the STL's _Checked_popcount, _Checked_x86_x64_countl_zero and _Float_multi_prec::_Sqr_x2 inline them; Cerid's own code only lowers and reports it (cpu_features.cpp)
floor.reason: compiler and STL runtime dispatch; an applied CRD_CPU_LEVEL lowers __isa_available to its level before the first user initializer (cpu_features.cpp), and the integer paths give the baseline path's results

floor.guard: the STL's __std_* algorithms test __isa_available before entering their SSE4.2, AVX2 and AVX-512 bodies
floor.reason: the static part of the MSVC STL linked into every image (std::find, std::search, ...)

floor.guard: out of line (unoptimized builds) _Float_multi_prec::_Sqr_x2 calls it only when __isa_available reports AVX2
floor.reason: <complex>'s exact squares (std::abs, std::norm) in unoptimized MSVC builds

floor.guard: out of line (unoptimized builds) the helpers holding POPCNT or LZCNT are called only after _Checked_popcount or _Checked_x86_x64_countl_zero tested __isa_available
floor.reason: std::popcount and std::countl_zero in unoptimized MSVC builds

floor.guard: the CRT's vector math entry points the vectorizer calls (__vdecl_floor2 and the others, svml_*_dispatch.obj) compare __isa_available before jumping to a body above SSE2
floor.reason: MSVC's vectorized math library calls at /O2 under every /arch; an applied CRD_CPU_LEVEL lowers __isa_available first

floor.guard: cpu_features.cpp reads XCR0 only when CPUID.1:ECX.OSXSAVE is set
floor.reason: CPU detection reads the OS-enabled register state (ADR-0134 §2)

floor.guard: zstd's DYNAMIC_BMI2 builds the _bmi2 bodies with target("lzcnt,bmi,bmi2") and calls them only when ZSTD_cpuid_bmi2 reports BMI1 and BMI2
floor.reason: zstd's Huffman and sequence decoders, GCC and Clang only

floor.guard: zstd assembles huf_decompress_amd64.S only with DYNAMIC_BMI2 and selects the loops only when HUF_flags_bmi2 (ZSTD_cpuid_bmi2) is set
floor.reason: zstd's assembly Huffman loops (shrx, shlx), GCC and Clang only

floor.guard: with DYNAMIC_BMI2 zstd builds the fast Huffman decoders and their C loops with target("lzcnt,bmi,bmi2") (HUF_FAST_BMI2_ATTRS), and HUF_decompress4X[12]_usingDTable_internal returns through the default decoder before reaching them unless HUF_flags_bmi2 (ZSTD_cpuid_bmi2) is set
floor.reason: zstd's fast Huffman decoders (shlx, shrx), out of line in unoptimized GCC and Clang builds
